headline: Key Fronts Intensify as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the most contested corridors have deepened their exchange of fire. Nevish Line now records 50 ownership changes in the past day, with Colonial and Warden casualties climbing at roughly 283 and 300 per hour respectively and both rates still accelerating. Palantine Berm has surged to 47 flips; its one‑hour casualty rates have risen to 19 and 25 per hour and are accelerating, while enlistments show a modest cooling. Callahans Passage holds at 26 flips, each side suffering near 500 casualties per hour with rates accelerating, though new enlistments are easing. Weathered Expanse adds 23 exchanges, combined losses exceeding 11 000 in the last 24 hours and both casualty trends accelerating sharply, with enlistments also rising. Kuura Strand’s activity has tapered to 14 events after a sharp two‑hour spike; casualty rates are flat but enlistments are beginning to accelerate. Stlican Shelf registers 12 flips, with both sides inflicting about 190 casualties per hour and rates accelerating. Marban Hollow and Mooring County each report a handful of recent captures, the former’s latest event logged at the prior cutoff. The remainder of the map remains largely static, most regions wholly held by a single faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity reported.
